transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

Annoying, but this is very common after cleaning and usually easy to fix. Water or cleaning spray has almost certainly got into the ignition switches or around the igniters, and the moisture is making them spark on their own.

Do this first
1. Turn the hob off at the wall/isolator switch (usually behind the hob or a switch nearby labelled "cooker"). That stops the clicking straight away. The gas supply stays off unless you turn a knob, so this is safe.
2. Pull off the control knobs (they usually just pull straight up). Wipe and dry underneath them.
3. Take off the burner caps and rings and make sure they're completely dry, including the little white ceramic igniter tips and the area around them.

Dry it out
• Leave the knobs and burner parts off and let it air dry for several hours, ideally overnight.
• To speed it up, use a hairdryer on low/warm around the knob areas and igniters for a few minutes (not too close).
• Don't put the burner parts back until they're bone dry.

Then test
• Put everything back, making sure the burner caps sit flat and correctly (a wonky cap can cause problems too).
• Switch the power back on. Usually the clicking has stopped.

If it still clicks
• Leave it switched off for another day. Sometimes moisture takes 24 to 48 hours to fully clear.
• Check that a knob isn't stuck slightly "on" or sticky from cleaner residue. Clean around it with a barely damp cloth, then dry.
• If it still won't stop after it's had a good chance to dry out, the ignition switch may be damaged and needs a Gas Safe registered engineer (UK) or a qualified appliance technician.

Safety
• If you ever smell gas, don't use switches or flames. Open windows, turn off the gas at the meter, and call the gas emergency line (0800 111 999 in the UK).
• Next time, spray cleaner onto the cloth rather than the hob, and avoid soaking around the knobs and igniters.

Nine times out of ten, leaving it unplugged to dry overnight sorts it. 👍
